Configure your server for team shuffle games.

Use the buttons below to get started.

help.title: TeamShuffler — Help
help.description: Instantly shuffle voice channel members into balanced teams.

setup.title: Server setup
setup.description: **Admin only.** Opens an interactive panel to create the Team Creation category, set a Game Manager role, and choose the bot language.

game.title: Create teams
game.description:
Shuffles everyone in your voice channel into two teams.
— Handles odd numbers (spectator or uneven split)
— Reroll until you're happy, then hit **Play!** to move players into dedicated channels
— Channels are deleted automatically when everyone leaves

help.footer: Only Game Managers and server admins can run /game.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a_who_game: Members with the **Game Manager** role and server admins. Set the role in `/setup`.
faq.q_rename: Can I rename the Team Creation channels?
faq.a_rename: Yes — channel names are cosmetic, the bot tracks them by ID. Rename freely.
faq.q_odd: What happens if there's an odd number of players?
faq.a_odd: The bot offers two options: drop one player to spectator (even teams) or keep everyone with an uneven split.
faq.q_multi: Can multiple games run at the same time?
faq.a_multi: Yes! Each creation channel is independent. Use different channels to run parallel games.
faq.a_cleanup: They delete when **all** members leave both Team A and Team B. A safety verification also runs every 5 minutes.
faq.q_lang: How do I change the bot language?
faq.a_lang: Open {cmd} → **Change Language**. Currently supported: English, French, German and Spanish.
faq.q_more_channels: Can I have more than 3 creation channels?
faq.a_more_channels: Not yet — re-running {cmd} → **Create Category** always creates exactly 3.
